note: Round 3 raised 2 narrower variants in the same two areas, prompting a structural (token-aware scanner + strict segment shape) rewrite rather than another regex patch. Round 4 returned VERIFIED.

issues.summary: The TempVars regex still matched inside bracketed spans when TempVars was not the first character after '[' (e.g. [prompt TempVars!x]).
issues.fix: Replaced the regex with a token-aware single-pass scanner that skips entire string-literal and bracketed spans and only matches TempVars at a top-level position.

issues.summary: ParseFormRefPath still accepted malformed paths with extra '!' segments such as [Forms]![frm]!![txtId].
issues.fix: Require exactly 2 or 3 segments after split, a Forms/Reports root, and non-empty object/member slots; otherwise return (null, null) -> unresolvable-reference.
